scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] plans an upper-body combination for long concrete walks, steep stairs, hard seats, standing, dancing, temperature changes, and phone security, comparing how closely the base and removable layer sit without riding, clinging, obscuring pockets, or becoming cumbersome when tied at the waist.
examples: keeping a closer base stable while dancing under a removable overshirt
using an easy T-shirt only when its extra fabric does not block secure front pockets
checking the full outfit while seated before committing to several hours in the stadium
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加体育场里的 R&B 演唱会时，[X]会规划一套能应对混凝土长距离步行、陡峭台阶、硬座、久站、舞动、温差和手机防盗的上装组合，并比较贴身内层与可脱外层如何避免上窜、黏身、遮住安全口袋，或系在腰间时过于累赘。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool cloudy day, [X] draws on limited styling experience to build an outfit around an owned thin black bomber jacket, checking it over a T-shirt, sweatshirt, or hoodie for shoulder clearance, hem overlap, elastic-waist placement, arm movement, and whether the inner layer creates bulk or hangs conspicuously below it.
examples: keeping the owned jacket's actual silhouette fixed while changing only the base layer
raising both arms to see whether a close inner top pulls the jacket upward
rejecting an oversized hoodie when its body or hood crowds the thin outer layer
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在阴冷多云的一天，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会围绕已有的一件黑色轻薄飞行夹克，分别叠穿 T 恤、卫衣或连帽衫，检查肩部余量、下摆重叠、松紧腰位置、手臂活动，以及内层是否造成鼓包或明显长出外套。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After uploading two previously worn outfits, [X] evaluates the same upper-body area with high-waisted straight trousers or skirts, comparing how close-fitting, balanced, and roomier silhouettes change visible waist placement, torso length, stacked bulk, and comfort before adding a fitted jacket or sweater.
examples: using the photographed outfit as evidence rather than inventing a new body shape
checking whether a close cropped top keeps the raised waist visually clear
rejecting extra ease when it bunches under the proposed outer layer or shortens the torso
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 上传两套近期真实穿过的搭配后，[X]会把同一上半身区域与高腰直筒裤或半身裙一起评估，比较更贴身、均衡或更宽松的轮廓如何改变腰线可见度、躯干长度、叠加体积和舒适度，再决定是否加一件合体夹克或毛衣。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When turning a mental image into a first top, [X] takes body measurements, selects a simple pattern, and makes a muslin before cutting final cloth, pinning and resewing the shoulders, chest, waist, armholes, and hem until the intended closeness survives breathing, sitting, reaching, and dressing without losing the planned line.
examples: adding balanced ease where the muslin pulls across the chest
removing excess body width without restricting a full forward reach
testing a deliberately close silhouette only in a compatible stretch construction
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把脑中的第一件上衣变成实物时，[X]会量取身体尺寸、选择简单纸样并先做坯布样衣，在裁剪正式面料前反复别合和重缝肩、胸、腰、袖窿与下摆，直到目标贴合程度能承受呼吸、坐下、伸手和穿脱，又不破坏预期线条。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While working alternating two-week morning and night blocks, [X] chooses pajama tops by how much room remains breathable in a cool dark room, avoids twisting or bunching while turning, and stays comfortable across both continuous sleep and a four-to-five-hour plus two-to-three-hour split schedule.
examples: using a balanced silhouette that does not wind around the torso during a long sleep block
leaving relaxed room for daytime sleep after a night commute
avoiding so much excess fabric that the top gathers when the second sleep block begins
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在交替的两周早班和两周夜班中，[X]会选择睡衣上装，比较多少余量能在凉爽黑暗的房间里保持透气、翻身时不扭转或堆积，并同时适合一次连续睡眠和“先睡四五小时、再睡两三小时”的分段作息。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a first date, [X] uploads three concrete outfit candidates and compares how each shirt sits while standing and seated, selecting one that matches a relaxed coffee shop or a more formal dinner without pulling across the body, collapsing into a sloppy shape, or demanding adjustment during conversation.
examples: keeping the casual candidate easy but neat for coffee
choosing a closer dinner shirt only when buttons and shoulders remain calm while seated
using the versatile middle option when the venue may change without relabeling any photographed outfit
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 第一次约会前，[X]会上传三套具体候选搭配，比较每件衬衫在站立和坐下时的状态，并选择既适合轻松咖啡馆或较正式晚餐、又不会横向拉扯、松垮失形或在谈话中反复需要整理的一套。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for a comfortable spring-and-autumn T-shirt to wear with jeans, [X] uploads one specific white candidate and carries that shirt through different jeans, a cap, necklace, bag, outerwear, and body-proportion questions, checking whether its actual silhouette stays intentional when tucked, layered, or worn alone.
examples: judging the uploaded shirt's real body width rather than assuming it from the color
checking whether a partial tuck creates pulling or uncontrolled blousing
keeping enough room under a light jacket without losing the simple line when the jacket is removed
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选购一件春秋季配牛仔裤的舒适 T 恤时，[X]会上传一件具体白色候选，并让同一件上衣经历不同牛仔裤、帽子、项链、包、外套和身材比例问题，检查它在塞衣角、叠穿或单穿时的真实轮廓是否始终显得搭配得当。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a one-week Easter trip split between Stone Town and a Zanzibar beach base, [X] chooses a small set of tops that ventilate in humidity, cover shoulders in local communities, dry after showers, sit comfortably in transfers, and remain secure on boat or snorkeling days without clinging or exposing more than intended.
examples: leaving easy room in a town shirt while preserving respectful coverage
using a stable closer base only for active water or boat movement
rejecting an excessively loose layer when wind, wet fabric, or repeated transfers make it awkward
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为复活节期间的一周桑给巴尔行程打包，住宿分布在石头城和海滩据点时，[X]会选择少量上衣，使其能在湿热中通风、进入社区时遮住肩部、阵雨后较快恢复、转乘时坐得舒服，并在乘船或浮潜日保持稳定，不黏身也不过度暴露。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a long-awaited countryside visit to their grandmother, [X] chooses tops that remain neat through a long train or bumpier bus ride, layer under a sweater or rain jacket, and still allow bending, carrying gifts and luggage, walking on uneven ground, and helping around the house after arrival.
examples: using a regular base that does not crease into tight pressure points after several seated hours
leaving relaxed room for a sweater without crowding the shoulders and torso
avoiding very loose fabric that catches while lifting luggage or walking a rural path
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 久别后去乡下探望祖母时，[X]会选择能在长途火车或较颠簸巴士中保持整洁、可叠穿毛衣或雨衣，并在到达后弯腰、搬礼物和行李、走不平路面以及帮忙做家务时仍活动自如的上衣。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a relaxed work-team event with lawn games, quick challenges, beanbag lounging, a shared meal, and group photographs, [X] chooses among T-shirts, polos, blouses, or casual shirts whose silhouettes feel easy without shifting, binding, exposing the waist, or looking untidy across active, seated, eating, and photographed moments.
examples: using a regular polo that stays composed from mingling to the group photo
choosing a relaxed shirt that allows lawn games and sitting on a blanket
avoiding a very close or very loose team tee that needs constant adjustment during challenges
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在包含草地游戏、快速挑战、豆袋休息、共享餐食和团队合照的轻松工作活动中，[X]会从 T 恤、Polo 衫、女衬衫或休闲衬衫中选择轮廓，让它在活动、坐卧、进食和拍照时既轻松，又不移位、勒紧、露腰或显得邋遢。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: While launching an Instagram scrub brand for medical students, a founder plans content that compares candidate scrub tops through lectures and clinical practice, recording shoulder and chest clearance, bending and reaching, long seated periods, pocket loading, heat, and whether the silhouette still looks professional after a full day.
examples: filming the same clinical movement sequence in each candidate size and silhouette
checking whether added room survives loaded pockets without sagging
asking students about restriction and constant adjustment rather than equating tighter with more professional
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名面向医学生创办 Instagram 手术服品牌的经营者规划内容，让候选手术服上衣经历课堂和临床实践，并记录肩胸余量、弯腰伸手、久坐、口袋装载、热感，以及一整天后轮廓是否仍显专业。
